title: Lee to host all ruling party lawmakers for luncheon next week
summary: President Lee Jae Myung plans to invite all lawmakers of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) for a luncheon next week, his office said Saturday. Lee will host the lawmakers at Cheong Wa Dae in Seoul next Friday ahead of the regular parliamentary session set to begin next month, according to Kang Yu-jung, senior presidential spokesperson. "As the luncheon is linked to the party's workshop schedule, it appears that all lawmakers will attend," a ruling party official said, adding that it plans to hold a two-day workshop starting Thursday to prepare for the regular session. In August last year, Lee also invited all DPK lawmakers to Cheong Wa Dae for a luncheon during their party workshop in an apparent bid to strengthen unity between the government and the ruling party.

title: US approves potential sale to Korea of AIM-9X air-to-air missiles
summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. government has authorized a potential sale to Korea of AIM-9X air-to-air missiles and related equipment, the State Department said Friday, noting that the proposed sale will help enhance the Asian ally's air defense capabilities. The department announced its decision on the potential government-to-government Foreign Military Sale, which is estimated to cost $125 million. The proposed sale requires congressional notification and review. Korea has requested the purchase of 103 AIM-9X Sidewinder Block II tactical missiles and 10 guidance units, as well as other non-major defense items, such as training aids and devices, and spare parts, according to the department. title: S. Korea, US wrap up drills early, day after NK missile barrage
summary: SEOUL — The U.S. and South Korean militaries wrapped up their annual drill on Friday, six days earlier than initially scheduled, in a conciliatory gesture toward North Korea, though Pyongyang said the step isn't enough to persuade it to return to talks. U.S. President Donald Trump had earlier abruptly ordered the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” the Ulchi Freedom Shield (UFS) exercise just before it began Monday. Trump cited what he described as a good relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and South Korea’s refusal to support him over the war in Iran.
